props.gloss_en: the mishna: a thigh in which the sciatic nerve was cooked -- if there is [enough] to impart flavor, it is forbidden
the mishna: how does one assess it? as meat in a turnip
Rav Huna: [the mishna's 'as meat in a turnip' means] as meat in turnip-heads
the stam: our mishna is not in accordance with this tanna
the thigh [cooked with its sciatic nerve] is permitted
R' Yehuda bar Zevina: bring it before him again
